Minimum active degree2 and <=4 edges exhaust the eight colored supports: LC pair, two triangle colorings, doubled triangle, shared/disjoint pairs and two four-cycle colorings. Multiple edges are counted in degrees.

Resistor and inactive LC edges preserve mode levels. A single connected active component must meet level zero. A one-anchor appendage has a constant-potential positive-real energy minimizer and can be removed; its inactive zero-level remainder has<=2 reactives.
Two active LC pairs are individually tuned by degree-two KCL; their admittances are invariant under s->1/s. Four-cycle opposite zero vertices split into two tuned series LC arcs.

Different internal levels forbid a resistor connection; disconnected same-level attachments are also removable. Equal internal levels force opposite LC order and equal positive L values. The internal R network reduces to positive r, with the derived bridge formula invariant under inversion.

Arbitrary outer resistor networks preserve rational response equality and inversion symmetry. Their count and values are not discretized. R open/wire operations apply to actual processed graphs, not arbitrary limiting coefficient representatives.
